boundary: This closes the torsion-prime local atlas, not the unconditional factorization of every global field discriminant. The latter still requires factoring or otherwise certifying the ten residual integers.

global_order_status.meaning: PARI nfcertify returned an empty residual only for fields 1-7. For fields 8-17, the recorded global field discriminants remain conditional on unresolved certification residuals.

local_certification: Each record was produced with nfinit([f,1000]); therefore the maximal order and ideal decomposition are certified at every prime below 1000, in particular at 2,3,5,7,13. The local torsion-prime statements do not depend on factoring the large global residuals.
theorem: All seventeen spectral factors have a complete exact local ramification atlas at 2,3,5,7,13. The degree sum is 256 and every field is totally real. The polynomial discriminant excess at each torsion prime is exactly twice the local power-basis index valuation. Global maximal-order certification is complete for fields 1-7 and remains conditional for fields 8-17.
